children: John Farahi, a 10% owner and CEO, sold 5,000 shares of the company's common stock at $124.00 per share on September 17, 2026, representing a total sale of $620,000. The filing states the shares sold were from Mr. Farahi's Foundation account. Following the transaction, Farahi directly owns 611,556 shares and indirectly owns 2,521,415 shares in trusts.
